attributes.board_name: Louisiana State Board of Medical Examiners

rules.accepted_credit_types: Category 1 CME from ACCME-accredited providers, ABMS member boards or AOA-recognized specialty boards, AAFP, ACOG, AOA, or entities accredited by the Louisiana State Medical Society or another ACCME-recognized state medical society
rules.new_licensee_rule: Annual CME does not apply to a physician holding an initial Louisiana license by examination for less than one year. Before the first renewal: a board orientation program (Laws and Rules course, at least 2 hours, credited hour-for-hour) and, for CDS prescribers, the one-time 3-hour CDS course.
rules.alternatives: Exempt from annual CME: physicians certified or recertified within the past year by an ABMS member board or AOA-recognized specialty board, residents in board-approved programs, military service over one year outside Louisiana, retired physicians. Hardship waiver on written request.
rules.audit_note: CE must be posted to CE Broker (the board's electronic education tracker); renewal is blocked if CE Broker does not show the required credits. Keep certificates at least 4 years; the board may audit.

topics.who: Board orientation / Laws and Rules course for physicians before the first renewal
Holders of a Louisiana CDS license and all residents; board pre-approved course covering CDS prescribing, drug diversion, addiction treatment and chronic pain; due before first renewal

rules.notes: One board licenses MDs and DOs with identical rules. 20 hours every year, renewal in the birth month (renew up to 56 days before expiry). CDS-CME exemption possible if no CDS prescribed in Louisiana during the prior year.
rules.legal_basis: La. Admin. Code tit. 46, Pt. XLV, §§433-449 (Subchapter K, Continuing Medical Education); CDS-CME: Act 76 of 2017, Board rules Chapter 40 (§4005)
